_comment_instructions: This file contains settings for name corrections and AI trigger phrases. The easiest way to change them is Settings > Words (corrections) and Settings > Triggers (trigger phrases); you can also edit this file.
_comment_trigger_phrases: trigger_phrases: what you say to hand a dictation to the AI. Each row is a phrase and what it does. "edit": the AI editor follows what you say after the phrase ("Meeting moved to noon. Prompt AI, make this formal"). "end": marks the end of your spoken instruction ("end prompt"). Capital letters don't matter, and the words may run together or have commas, dots or dashes between them. A word typed in capitals (2 to 5 letters, like AI or GPT) is an acronym, so "prompt AI" also catches "prompt a.i.", "promptai" and "prompt A. Eye".
_comment_legacy_triggers: Older versions stored triggers as regular expressions in trigger_patterns. Those are still read when trigger_phrases is missing, and ignored once it exists. Mean mode (the old "mean" rows and roast_trigger_patterns) is no longer built in: add it from Settings > Triggers > Custom triggers > Browse the library, under Fun. Leftover "mean" rows are ignored.
_comment_vocabulary: vocabulary: words Whisper should be biased toward spelling correctly (passed as faster-whisper hotwords). Every name_corrections target is added automatically. Keep it short -- a few dozen words max; restart the FasterWhisperAPI service after editing.
